spellfire-sorcery.summary: A Sorcerer who channels spellfire, the raw radiance of the Weave, to heal friends, burn foes and drink in hostile magic.

Spellfire Burst.summary: Once per turn, when you spend Sorcery Points in a Magic action or Bonus Action, a creature within 30 ft (or you) gains 1d4 + CHA Temporary HP, or a creature within 30 ft takes 1d4 Fire or Radiant.

options.name: Bolstering Flames
options.summary: You or a creature you see within 30 ft gains 1d4 + CHA Temporary HP.

options.name: Radiant Fire
options.summary: A creature you see within 30 ft takes 1d4 Fire or Radiant, your pick.

Spellfire Spells.summary: Always prepared: Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration and Scorching Ray at Sorcerer 3; Aura of Vitality and Dispel Magic at 5; Fire Shield and Wall of Fire at 7; Greater Restoration and Flame Strike at 9.

Absorb Spells.summary: Counterspell is always prepared, and you regain 1d4 Sorcery Points whenever a target fails its save against your Counterspell.

Honed Spellfire.summary: Bolstering Flames adds your Sorcerer level to its Temporary HP, and Radiant Fire deals 1d8.

Crown of Spellfire.summary: Once per Long Rest (or by spending 5 Sorcery Points), Innate Sorcery also grants a 60-ft Fly Speed with hover, lets you burn up to CHA Hit Point Dice once per turn to cut a hit's damage, and turns half-damage saves into no damage on a success and half on a failure.

options.name: Burning Life Force
options.summary: Once per turn when an attack roll hits you, spend up to CHA modifier Hit Point Dice (min 1) and subtract their roll from the damage.

options.name: Flight
options.summary: Fly Speed 60 ft; you can hover.

options.name: Spell Avoidance
options.summary: Against a spell or magical effect whose save halves damage, take none on a success and half on a failure; not while Incapacitated.
